EquipmentHands.title: Hands and weapon setup
EquipmentHands.hold: Hold / ready this object or attack
EquipmentHands.hands: Occupied hands (0 only for an explicitly hands-free attack or object)
EquipmentHands.zeroHint: A zero-hand attack must first be declared by the GM for this Item. This cannot bypass a heavy or explicitly two-handed weapon requirement.
EquipmentHands.operators: Other participating operators (Ctrl/Cmd to select several)
EquipmentHands.crewHint: The acting character counts as one operator. Participants must be distinct actual characters and able to operate the weapon. Participation and deployment are explicit declarations; no distance, bonus or action cost is inferred.
EquipmentHands.hint: Carrying equipment does not occupy hands. Declare what is actually held. Heavy weapons require two hands unless their source explicitly permits hindered one-handed use. Stowing an object keeps it in inventory. Conflicting grips never unequip another object.
EquipmentHands.needGrip: Declare that this attack or object is held before using it.
EquipmentHands.needTwoHands: The declared number of hands does not satisfy this weapon's requirements.
EquipmentHands.handsFull: Not enough free hands. Stow another object or ask the GM to adjust available hands.
EquipmentHands.needTripod: Deploy the required tripod before attacking.
EquipmentHands.needCrew: Assign enough distinct available operators before attacking.
EquipmentHands.invalid: Declaration refused. Check free hands, source requirements, shield possession and available distinct operators. Nothing else was unequipped.
